declaration.selection_rule: I01 requires max actual cross-belt cell length / ell <= 0.25. With unchanged 12 longitude sectors, a great-circle latitude edge bulges by at most sec(15 degrees); ceil((100000 / 2) / (0.25 * 5000) / cos(15 degrees)) = 42 rows per side. The second grid halves the nominal spacing. Actual cell lengths are checked on both start and endpoint belts.
